Equation 13:
\mu=\mu_{max}\Bigg[1-\Bigg(\frac{S}{S_{m}}\Bigg)\Bigg]^{n}\left[\frac{S}{S+K_{s}\Big(1-\frac{S}{S_{m}}\Big)^{m}}\right]

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu  ->  mu   (Specific bacteria growth rate)
  S  ->  S_   (Substrate concentration)
  K_{s}  ->  Ks   (Half saturation constant)
  S_{m}  ->  Sm   (Critical inhibitor concentration.)
  m  ->  m   (Cell-maintenance parameter in the Powell law; exponent in the Han-Levenspiel law.)
  \mu_{max}  ->  mumax   (Maximum specific growth rate)
  n  ->  n   (Growth-law exponent parameter)
